notes.official_snapshot: single standard/fresh public Official snapshot owner
notes.official_detail: single expensive/broad public Official detail owner; it must consume snapshot for standard endpoints and may network-fetch only additional detail/historical-pick evidence
notes.official_fetch_guard: every engine module importing the public Official transport must be explicitly mapped to its logical service owner; helper-module indirection cannot bypass ownership checks
notes.rules: Official rule constants and derived canonical rule symbols are defined only by src/rules.py
notes.legality: FPL squad and XI legality functions are defined only by src/domain/fpl_legality.py; optimizer and governance are consumers
notes.architecture_guard: ownership validation belongs in CI/release acceptance and never becomes a new runtime service or critical-path hop
notes.authenticated_official: private authorized reads use dedicated official_auth transport and are not standard public Official fetch duplication
notes.bundles: FAST bundles may call existing service-stage functions in process but may not define a second football formula or source authority
